per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must be unique across all records
S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be exactly 4 digits when represented as string
Name must not be null
Name must follow Title Case convention except for recognized lowercase particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must conform to Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one prefix letter (S/T/F/G), followed by exactly 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
Race must not be null
Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Gender must not be null
Gender must be either Male or Female (Title Case)
Age must be numeric parseable (no text representations)
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
Age must be at least 13 years for consumer service accounts
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number with 8-digit local number
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
Country must not be null
Country must be the canonical value 'Singapore'
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must follow Title Case convention
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column: Bin or s/o indicates Male; Binte or d/o indicates Female
Account_No must match the Account_No value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
ID_No must match the ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Name must match the Full_Name value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for standardization differences)
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
